The forward LEADER_SCHEDULE scan did NOT recompute past the horizon (no new LEADER_SCHEDULE, no SCHEDULE_EMPTY, SCHEDULE_NEXT stale at 115103987) — yet the node FORGED this block via the independent per-slot EVENT_LEADER_DETECTED path (u_x1e12=31520162 < thresh 89407601). INC-014 root cause re-opened: the 26h drought required the per-slot path to ALSO halt, which this experiment shows is a deeper/separate failure than the forward-scan miss alone.
